// _NOTE_: Example Claude Code settings.json. Copy this into ~/.claude/settings.json
(or the project-local .claude/settings.json) and adjust to taste.
Hook command paths use ~/.claude/hooks/ — copy the sibling .sh files
in this directory there, or change the paths to wherever you keep them.
Comments are not standard JSON; they live here as `// _xxx_` keys
which Claude Code ignores but a human reader sees.

permissions.// _what_: Hard deny list: agent cannot read keys/certs even if it asks.

// _hooks_: The six hook event types Claude Code dispatches.
Each hook is a shell command; exit 2 BLOCKS the tool call (PreToolUse).
Non-zero exit on other events surfaces a warning but does not block.

PreToolUse.// _matcher_: git commit text — exit 2 if message contains AI/Claude attribution
edits to .env / .pem / .key / *_rsa — exit 2 to block writes

PostToolUse.// _matcher_: after every Edit/Write: lint and verify the ABOUTME header

PostCompact.// _what_: Re-anchor context after Claude's history compaction so the agent doesn't forget the rules

Stop.// _what_: Run the project's tests automatically after the agent finishes a response
